class.name: DVColorScale
class.brief_description: One seed colour expanded into an ordered ladder of steps.
class.description: A supporting resource for [DVColorSystem]. A scale holds the steps generated from a single seed colour, from which surfaces, borders and text colours are picked. Together with the domain enums it is what lets a theme be described by a handful of seeds rather than dozens of individual colours.

constants.constant: Surfaces: the plot ground, panel fills, row stripes.
Labels and values. Sub-index 0 is primary text, 1 secondary.
Chart furniture: gridlines, axis lines, tick marks.
Highlights, selection and the keyboard focus ring.
Success, warning, error and info, by sub-index.
The categorical palette charts colour their series from. Sub-index is the series number.
Text colour is derived from the background, for contrast alone.
Text colour comes from [member DVTheme.palette/text_seed], adjusted to meet the contrast target.
Text colour is tinted with the primary seed.
